verdict: Too dense to survive as ONE mesh.
If it is meant to be seen from a distance, render it to a skybox,
Tiling instead: 8 meshes keeps 25% of the detail (71,500 triangles);
Tiling instead: 15 meshes keeps 50% of the detail (143,001 triangles);
the 10,000 cap is PER MESH, so `tile` beats `decimate` for anything
broad that the player gets close to. Weigh the part count against
LOOK at views.png before building: generated meshes copy the reference's floor,
cables and loose props, and glass comes out as an opaque slab. Numbers miss both.
decision: High-quality all-angle lobby column. Preserve the source GLB's blue-gray stone finish; adjacent lobby images have different finishes and are not an approved color target. Textured 8% and 15% reduction trials were inspected: 8% adds shaft artifacts, while 15% retains the damaged capital, smooth shaft and stepped base. Use the 15% version (42,900 triangles), divided into six meshes, at a provisional 12-stud height. Local export checks, visual approval, Studio import and lobby integration are separate stages.
